## Services
- 3shape Digital Scanner
  3shape digital intraoral scanner for precise digital impressions.
- All-on-4
  A revolutionary implant procedure that completely replaces an entire arch of teeth using only four implants.
- Bone Grafts
  Bone grafting procedures, typically performed to prepare the jaw for dental implants.
- Bridges
  Dental bridges to replace one or more missing teeth by anchoring to adjacent natural teeth.
- Brushing & Flossing Instruction
  Oral hygiene instruction for pediatric patients and their parents on proper brushing and flossing techniques.
- CandidPro
  CandidPro clear aligner treatment option available at Arizona Biltmore Dentistry.
- Children's Exams & Cleanings
  Comprehensive oral exams and cleanings for pediatric patients, including a risk assessment for cavities.
- Clear Aligners
  An 'invisible' type of braces that uses a series of clear, removable aligners to move teeth into alignment, available for adults and teens.
- ClearCorrect Aligners
  A digitally mapped invisible aligner system using 3D scanning technology and BPA-free transparent trays to gradually straighten teeth, backed by over 15 years of success.
- Cosmetic Dentistry
  A range of affordable in-office cosmetic dentistry procedures designed to improve smile aesthetics, including veneers, orthodontics, teeth whitening, and more.
- Crowns
  Dental crowns to restore damaged, weakened, or post-root-canal teeth, available for both pediatric and adult patients.
- Deep Cleaning
  Periodontal deep cleaning (scaling and root planing) to treat gum disease.
- Dental Bonding
  Cosmetic dental bonding procedure to correct smile imperfections.
- Dental Implants
  Start-to-finish dental implant treatment to replace one or more missing natural teeth caused by tooth decay, periodontal disease, or injury.
- Dental Sealants
  Preventive dental sealants applied to children's teeth to protect against decay.
- Denture Stabilization
  Implant-based stabilization of existing dentures to prevent slipping and improve comfort.
- Dentures
  Fully customized full and partial dentures to restore a patient's smile, including traditional and implant-stabilized options.
- DIAGNOdent®
  DIAGNOdent® laser cavity detection technology for early identification of tooth decay.
- Digital X-Rays & CBCT
  Digital X-rays and cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) imaging for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.
- Emergency Dental Service
  Emergency dental care for urgent dental issues, with a $99 emergency exam offer.
- Family Dentistry
  Comprehensive dental care for every member of the family, focused on building good oral health habits and lifelong dental hygiene.
- Fluoride Treatments
  Preventive fluoride treatments for pediatric patients to strengthen tooth enamel and prevent decay.
- Full & Partial Dentures
  Custom full and partial dentures listed as a restorative dentistry service.
- General Dentistry
  Comprehensive general dentistry services for patients of all ages at Arizona Biltmore Dentistry.
- Guided Implant Surgery
  Computer-guided implant surgery technology for precise and predictable implant placement.
- Implant-Stabilized Dentures
  Dentures anchored in place using implant posts inserted into the jaw bone, providing a more permanent and stable solution than traditional dentures.
- In-Office Teeth Whitening Treatment
  In-office professional whitening session with custom trays and take-home bleach for touch-ups, completed in approximately one hour.

## Frequently Asked Questions
**Q:** Am I a Candidate for Dental Implants?
**A:** If you're missing one or more teeth and in good general health, you're likely a good implant candidate. Dr. Jeziorski will assess your specific situation during your initial consultation.

**Q:** What Are My Tooth Replacement Options with Dental Implants?
**A:** Options range from single-tooth implants to full mouth restorations and denture stabilization, all tailored to meet your needs.

**Q:** How Long Do Dental Implants Last?
**A:** With proper care, dental implants can last a lifetime.

**Q:** Is the Dental Implant Procedure Painful?
**A:** For dental implant treatment, most patients report minimal discomfort, with local anesthesia, or general anesthesia used during the procedure to ensure patient comfort.

**Q:** What Does the Dental Implant Procedure Involve?
**A:** It typically is oral surgery that will place implants, a healing period, and the attachment of a custom-made crown.

**Q:** How Much Do Dental Implants Cost?
**A:** Cost varies based on the type and number of implants. Our office offers financing options to make the procedure accessible.

**Q:** What Are Implants?
**A:** Dental implants represent a groundbreaking leap forward in the realm of dental technology, meticulously crafted to fill the void left by missing teeth with artificial substitutes that not only mirror the appearance of natural teeth but also emulate their feel and functionality to near perfection. These sophisticated devices are securely embedded into the jawbone, serving as robust pillars for the attachment of new teeth. This direct anchorage into the upper jaw bone not only ensures the stability and durability of the implant but also plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity of the jawbone density, and facial structure. By preventing the bone loss commonly associated with missing teeth, dental implants contribute significantly to preserving the natural contour of the face and overall oral health. Their design and implementation are the culmination of years of scientific research and clinical advancements, making them a preferred choice for individuals looking to restore their smiles to their natural glory.

**Q:** Are Implants Safe?
**A:** Absolutely. Dental implants have a high success rate and are considered a safe and effective solution for patients replacing missing teeth. With proper care and maintenance, risks and complications of implant failure are minimal.

**Q:** Are Implants Worth it?
**A:** Considering their natural appearance, ability to improve quality of life, and long-term benefits, dental implants are an incredibly beneficial option and worthwhile investment for many patients seeking to replace missing teeth.

**Q:** What is All-on-4?
**A:** All-on-4 treatment utilizes the integrity of four strategically-placed dental implants to support a hybrid, full-arch restoration. This streamlined device merges the efficiency of dentures with the comfort and functionality of dental implants. Only in this case, there are no bulky "plates" across the roof of your mouth or devices to take out at night; everything is naturally designed and permanently affixed into place.

With All-on-4 implants, a "U" shaped appliance is permanently attached to the four implants underneath. All of the teeth in your upper or lower arch are replaced at the same time.
